### ManagerRuntime

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Version` | `string` | The version string of the running systemd instance |
| `Architecture` | `string` | A short ID string describing the architecture the systemd instance is running on |

| `Taints` | `?[]string` | An array of strings describing the taints applied to the running system |
| `UnitPath` | `[]string` | The unit search path |

| `ConfidentialVirtualization` | `string` | A short ID string describing the confidential virtualization technology the system runs in |
| `FirmwareTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the firmware first began execution |
| `LoaderTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the boot loader first began execution |
| `KernelTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the kernel first began execution |
| `InitRDTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the initrd first began execution |
| `UserspaceTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the initrd first began execution |
| `FinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the system finished booting up |
| `ShutdownStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when shutdown began, i.e. when units started to be stopped |
| `ShutdownFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when all units finished stopping during shutdown |
| `PreviousShutdownStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the previous boot began stopping units, restored across a kexec-based live update |
| `PreviousShutdownFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the previous boot finished stopping units, restored across a kexec-based live update |
| `PreviousShutdownLateStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when systemd-shutdown began execution during the previous boot, restored across a kexec-based live update |
| `PreviousShutdownLateFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when systemd-shutdown was about to kexec into the current kernel, restored across a kexec-based live update |
| `SecurityStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager started uploading security policies to the kernel |
| `SecurityFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager finished uploading security policies to the kernel |
| `GeneratorsStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager started executing generators |
| `GeneratorsFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager finished executing generators |
| `UnitsLoadStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager first started loading units |
| `UnitsLoadFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager first finished loading units |
| `UnitsLoadTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager last started loading units |
| `InitRDSecurityStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager started uploading security policies to the kernel in the initrd |
| `InitRDSecurityFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager finished uploading security policies to the kernel in the initrd |
| `InitRDGeneratorsStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager started executing generators in the initrd |
| `InitRDGeneratorsFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager finished executing generators in the initrd |
| `InitRDUnitsLoadStartTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager first started loading units in the initrd |
| `InitRDUnitsLoadFinishTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the manager first finished loading units in the initrd |
| `NNames` | `int` | The amount of unique unit names currently loaded |
| `NFailedUnits` | `int` | The amount of failed units |
| `NJobs` | `int` | The amount of currently queued jobs |
| `NInstalledJobs` | `int` | The total amount of queued jobs |
| `NFailedJobs` | `int` | The total amount of failed jobs |
| `TransactionsWithOrderingCycle` | `?[]int` | IDs of transactions that encountered ordering cycle |
| `Progress` | `float` | Boot progress as a floating point value between 0.0 and 1.0 |

| `ExitCode` | `int` | Exit code of the manager |
| `SoftRebootsCount` | `int` | Encodes how many soft-reboots were successfully completed |
